programs.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
programs.sub_title: Bamboo Shoots And Cured Ham Stir Fry
programs.desc: All through Anhui, locals cure their own pork in winter, often simply hanging a piece of pork in the cold, dry air and salting it every week or so. The result is a favourite ingredient in Anhui’s simple stir-fried dishes.

programs.title: Nigellissima
programs.desc: Nigella treats her friends to an Italian-style supper of pork loin stuffed with parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash.

programs.title: Nadiya's Family Favourites
programs.desc: Nadiya serves up indulgent dishes for treat days. On the menu are a ham and cheese crown, creamy spinach and paneer kati rolls, and sticky syrup sponge balls.

programs.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
programs.desc: Jamie travels to the snow-capped Italian Alps to seek out Piedmont's legendary comfort food. Plus, he cooks dumplings with roasted red onions and crispy pancetta.

programs.title: River Cottage: Veg
programs.desc: Hugh sets up a vegetable garden and then meets top vegetarian chef David Bailey.

programs.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programs.desc: The chef continues to explore his favourite locations in the Mediterranean, visiting Majorca to sample succulent roast lamb and seafood dishes. In Barcelona, he explores the city's famous Boqueria market and finds out about Catalan cuisine.
